verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is an API-driven cloud browser service, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question to ask. However, the probe found no spec at any standard path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json all 404). The human-readable API reference pages and llms.txt are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
